note: Provisional thresholds used by delta-based rules. Each is the midpoint of two sample means from one study of municipal homepages, compared against our own metric definition. Replace with our own measurements (research/measurements/, analysis A2) as soon as they exist. Only metrics with a number in the source are listed: for the others no threshold is invented. mainBlocks and peripheralBlocks are listed as references for the scorecard only (no rule uses them).

mediaPer1000Px.method: midpoint of the two sample means, rounded to 2 decimals

source.locator: Section 2.2 table: visual density (images/videos per 1,000 px) 38.21 China vs 12.87 West

caveats: Sample is municipal homepages, not commercial sites.
The report we hold does not say what '1,000 px' refers to; we measure per 1,000 px of page height, which may not match the study's unit, so the scale may differ.
Our metric counts images, pictures, videos, canvases and large SVGs; the study counts images and videos.

mainBlocks.method: midpoint of the two sample means (reference only)

source.locator: Section 2.2 table: main content blocks 5.91 China vs 3.14 West

caveats: Sample is municipal homepages, not commercial sites.
Figures as reported in docs/01; the primary text is not yet verified (rules/sources.json).
